guitar.notes: NWOBHM band, no single widely iconic signature documented.

tone.target: hot Marshall crunch with biting upper mids
tone.profile: hot Marshall crunch with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A classic British hard rock chain using a Boost for attack, Distortion for crunch, an AC30 TB amp model, and the UK Vintage 4x12 cab to deliver biting upper mids and tight rhythm performance.

rig.name: Saxon - Princess Of The Night - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum during tight palm-muting.
Increase pick attack and overall output level for aggressive rhythm playing.
Provide the core Marshall-style crunch and bite required for hard rock rhythm.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is a general choice to emulate Plexi/Marshall grit, as no specific British high-gain model (like UK 45) was available in the DST section. Using it before the amp helps shape the tone.

alternatives.reason: If a dedicated British overdrive were preferred over Distortion.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British tone (Plexi/Marshall) with emphasis on upper mids and bite.
Provide the necessary British cabinet voicing and punchy high-end response.
Aggressively boost the upper mids and high frequencies to achieve 'biting upper mids' punch.
Tighten the rhythm and sustain the aggressive pick attack.
blocks.gap: While compression is useful, placing it here (after distortion/before amp) helps control dynamics for tight palm-muting. A dedicated compressor module would be ideal.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth and space without muddying the hard rock punch.
blocks.gap: Delay is optional for this genre, but a short slapback or digital delay adds dimension to solos/fills.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space without losing the dry, punchy hard rock feel.
blocks.gap: A smaller room or plate reverb would be better to maintain tightness. Using Room sparingly is key.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and high-end bite by swapping the current IR for a more aggressive, Marshall-voiced 4x12.

proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, biting upper mids and overall Marshall character.
